claim: The joint application on Studyinfo.fi for English-taught bachelor's programmes starting autumn 2027 runs 7 to 21 January 2027. Attachments are due 28 January 2027, predicted IB grades are entered on Studyinfo by 1 April 2027, and official final IB grades are due 13 July 2027.
excerpt: Application period opens: 7 January 2027 … Application period ends / Deadline for submitting the application: 21 January 2027 … General deadline for application attachments to be uploaded on Studyinfo: 28 January 2027 … Deadline for submitting predicted grades on to your online application form on Studyinfo.fi: 1 April 2027 … Deadline for submitting official final grades: 13 July 2027
interpretation: Used for the national window because Studyinfo itself does not serve its content to a plain fetch. The final-grades date is Jyväskylä's own; it shows how a Finnish university bridges the gap between a January application and IB results in July. Other institutions set their own document dates.

attestation.by: the Nordic floor research pass (fi, is, mt)
attestation.note: The page says the exact time of several deadlines 'will be announced later', so no time of day is recorded.

claim: The University of Helsinki runs its own dates for English-taught bachelor's programmes: 5 to 19 January 2027 for Admission group 1, and 9 to 23 March 2027 for Admission group 2, which is the group for IB Diploma holders.
excerpt: The application periods for studies starting in autumn 2027 are 5–19 January 2027 (Admission group 1) OR 9–23 March 2027 (Admission group 2)
interpretation: Helsinki does not follow the 7–21 January national window. An IB Diploma candidate belongs to Admission group 2 and applies in March. The page also says instructions and criteria 'will be updated by the end of October 2026', so re-read it then.

attestation.by: the Nordic floor research pass (fi, is, mt)
attestation.note: The same page still carries the 2026 periods (2–16 Jan and 10–24 March 2026) lower down. The 2027 sentence is in the intro.

publisher: Study in Finland (Finnish National Agency for Education)
claim: The joint application for English-taught bachelor's and master's studies starting August/September 2027 is held 7–21 January 2027 at Studyinfo.fi, and an applicant may apply to up to six degree programmes.
excerpt: The joint application period to the English-taught Bachelor's and Master studies starting in August/September 2027 will be arranged 7 – 21 January 2027 at Studyinfo.fi. … You can apply to up to six different degree programmes

publisher: UAS Info (Finnish universities of applied sciences)
claim: Universities of applied sciences score the IB Diploma in certificate-based selection for English-taught bachelor's programmes, in the same way as the Finnish matriculation examination. Every applicant, native English speakers included, must still prove English proficiency.
excerpt: International Baccalaureate diploma (IB) … are scored similarly to the Finnish matriculation examination in certificate-based selection. … All applicants of the University of Applied Sciences' Bachelor's programmes, including native speakers of English, must demonstrate their English language proficiency.

attestation.by: the Nordic floor research pass (fi, is, mt)

excerpt: Universities offer Bachelor's and Master's degrees and academic, artistic and third-cycle postgraduate degrees. … Universities of applied sciences provide Bachelor's and Master's degrees.

claim: Citizens of the EU, EEA and Switzerland pay no tuition at the University of Helsinki. Others pay 13,000 euros a year for an English-taught bachelor's programme.
excerpt: citizens of the European Union (EU), the European Economic Area (EEA) and Switzerland … The fee for the English-language bachelor's programmes is 13,000 EUR per academic year.
interpretation: One university's figure, used as the example. Each institution sets its own non-EU fee.
